## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Blankenberge, Belgium. It starts at Koning Albert-1-laan 116.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Get immersed in the wonderful world of marine wildlife at SEA LIFE Blankenberge, Belgium's premier aquarium and sanctuary for sea creatures. See dozens of remarkable fish and animals species splashing about. It's as fun as it is educational, and a must for all wildlife enthusiasts.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €28.11. It was rated 3.8 out of 5 from 221 ratings and 112 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
